memberships.page_title: The Categorical Quotient of Bounded Cubic Frames

statement: For a kernel-of-an-endomorphism translation action over a Q-algebra, the invariant algebra is the kernel of the relative differential modulo im(M dual); for the bounded cubic-frame action, global invariants are the contraction of the localization at the single one-root wall q_N=0.
title: The Cubic-Frame Categorical Quotient Is a Differential Kernel Controlled by One Wall
